Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Grats! I never managed to win a final with a turbo nergal (there always a round where it doesn't start, either because of bad luck or rushing/intercepting prey/predator, and you have a big target on the head in the final).
I'm no big fan of Sense the Sin that disrupt a little the card flow.

What wera the round results?
